skill_name: Explain how to use the product
workflow: A robo advisor is an automated online service for investment management. It creates and manages an investment portfolio tailored to individual investors' needs, using data from the investor to assess their risk tolerance, goals, and time horizon. The robo advisor uses algorithms to allocate investments in a portfolio that can help pursue the investor's financial goals. In order to use a robo advisor, the investor has to fill a questionnaire to assess their risk profile, financial goals and time
